verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents native AI features for getting answers from your data inside the platform. Cortex Analyst lets business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL. Cortex AI Functions run LLM-powered analytics on text and images in your data, and the homepage pitches Snowflake CoWork as an 'ask anything' experience. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or recommendations (beyond answering asked questions), depth on how CoWork surfaces insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
